meaning:
Συχέμ indecl. (Heb. שְׁכֶם),
Shechem;
1. the son of Hamor (Gen.33:19): Act.7:16 b, Rec.
2. A city of Samaria (AV, Sychem; in LXX also sometimes Σίκιμα, -ων, as in FlJ): Act.7:16 a,b.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and they were brought back to Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
